motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: opacity 0 to 1, y 20 to 0 over 0.8s ease-out
motion_and_interactions.button_hover: relative overflow-hidden group hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:text-[#faf8f4] transition-colors duration-300
motion_and_interactions.product_card_hover: Add to Cart button slides up from bottom on hover. Image scales up slightly (1.05) over 0.7s ease
motion_and_interactions.custom_cursor: Implement a custom cursor using framer-motion: a small solid gold dot (#c9a84c) with a larger, trailing hollow ring.

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky nav with frosted glass (#faf8f4/80 + blur). Logo AURUM centered. Nav links minimal. Cart icon with absolute positioned badge.
components_instructions.hero: Split layout (text left, image right or vice versa). Headline in Cormorant Garamond. Floating animation on the product image. Infinite scrolling marquee strip at the bottom of the section.
components_instructions.featured_collections: 3-column grid. Large images with category titles overlaid (Rings, Bracelets, Necklaces). Use soft overlays.
components_instructions.product_grid: 4-column grid. Clean, lots of whitespace. Slide-up 'Add to Cart' button. Heart icon for Wishlist.
components_instructions.craftsmanship: Full-width two-column layout. One side editorial image, one side typography-heavy brand story.
components_instructions.testimonials: Auto-cycling minimal slider. Gold quote marks. Text large and italicized in Cormorant Garamond.
components_instructions.instagram_strip: 6 square images in a row. No gaps or 1px gold borders between them.
components_instructions.newsletter: Full width banner with champagne background (#e8d5a3). Elegant input field with bottom border only.
components_instructions.footer: 4 columns. Minimal links. Deep charcoal or cream background.
components_instructions.admin_dashboard: Use Shadcn components heavily. Sidebar for navigation. Complex tables for Products, Inventory, Orders. Recharts for revenue/trends analytics. JWT Authentication wrapped in context.
components_instructions.test_ids: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
